field.name: Name

field.selectProvider: Select a source with a URL

genericExec.title: Generic command config
genericExec.commandHint: Executable name or absolute path; {task} is not substituted here.
genericExec.deliveryHint: argv substitutes {task} in args; stdin pipes the task text (use for long text).
genericExec.argsHint: One argument per line; argv mode requires a {task} placeholder.

permission.pathsHint: Globs relative to project root, one per line; empty = no access.
permission.dangerousOpsNote: Dangerous ops (delete out of scope, git push, deploy…) always require per-time confirmation and cannot be disabled.
permission.layeringNote: This is an upper bound; each turn's effective scope is the intersection of all layers, further narrowed by the task contract the Planner dispatches.

defaultPermission.title: Default permission preset
defaultPermission.subtitle: The envelope pre-filled when creating a new profile.
defaultPermission.error: Failed to save the default permission preset

knowledgeTool.title: Knowledge search tool (MCP)
knowledgeTool.subtitle: How the agent-facing read-only search tool is launched. Leave blank to use the built-in server — most setups never need to change this.
knowledgeTool.transportNote: The transport is always stdio (a process pipe): no port is opened and no network traffic is produced, so it is unaffected by VPNs, system proxies and firewalls, and it does not disturb your other MCP servers.
knowledgeTool.serverNameHint: MCP server name registered with the agent. Blank uses {{name}}. A server you already have under the same name would collide.
knowledgeTool.commandHint: Blank uses the built-in server. Setting it takes over launching entirely, so provide the arguments too.
knowledgeTool.argsHint: Space separated. Editable only when an executable is set.
knowledgeTool.envHint: One KEY=VALUE per line. The index and audit paths are injected automatically; set them here only to override. Do not put secrets here.

configTool.title: Workbench self-configuration tool
configTool.subtitle: Lets the agent list providers/profiles (sanitized) and submit configuration drafts. Nothing is saved without your confirmation.
configTool.safetyNote: API keys never pass through the model: the tool physically has no key field. After you confirm a draft that needs a key, you enter it yourself in a secure input.
configTool.label: Enable for the current project
configTool.hint: Applies to project "{{project}}" only. Off by default; when off, the tool is not even registered with the agent.
configTool.enabledNote: Enabled: every write goes through draft validation and your confirmation dialog. All calls are audited in Runs.
configTool.needProject: Select a project first — this switch is per-project.

roles.title: Custom roles
roles.subtitle: Roles beyond the built-in Planner/Worker/Reviewer: name + role prompt + permission preset.
roles.empty: No custom roles yet. Create one and bind it in a Profile to use it.

edit.title: Edit role

field.name: Name

replay.interrupted: This turn was interrupted because the app quit

session.generatePlanHint: Plan generation always runs as the built-in Planner (the structured plan contract belongs to Planner), regardless of the currently selected discussion role.
session.directExecuteHint: Skip habit-based shaping for this turn and act directly (habits stay intact).

handoff.title: Cross-agent handoff
handoff.description: The handoff package contains only this project's plan, tasks and project memory. API keys, raw execution logs and other projects never enter it. Confirming starts a new session and hands the text below to the new agent.
handoff.targetHint: A new agent cannot pick up the old agent's session, so a handoff always starts a new session.
handoff.previewHint: Edit freely — what you leave here is exactly what gets injected.
handoff.kickoff: Read the handoff package above. First restate your understanding of the current progress and constraints, then say what you intend to do next. Do not start working yet.
handoff.migrated: Handed off. The package was injected into a new session.

inherit.title: Continue in fresh session
inherit.description: Packs this project's plan, tasks and project memory into a handoff package and injects it into a fresh session — the bloated old context is left behind, the working state is not. API keys and raw execution logs never enter it.
inherit.targetHint: Defaults to the current profile (fresh restart); you can also pick another profile to take over.
inherit.done: Fresh session started with the handoff package injected.
